name: Chamomile Tea
siboNotes: Chamomile tea is well-tolerated in SIBO and may have anti-inflammatory properties that support digestive health.
preparationTips: Steep 1-2 teaspoons dried chamomile flowers or 1 tea bag in hot water for 5-10 minutes
Avoid adding honey or agave (high FODMAP) - use maple syrup or stevia instead
Can be enjoyed hot or iced throughout the day
Quality varies - choose organic chamomile for best flavor and purity
nutritionalHighlights: Contains apigenin, an antioxidant with calming properties
